messages:
Alex: hey 👋 I'm prepping my first PR to adjust the runtime config defaults (kv cache ttl). Quick question — what's our branch/PR naming convention and who should I ping for a review?
Priya: welcome Alex! for branches we usually use `feat/<area>/<short-desc>` or `fix/<area>/<short-desc>`. e.g. `feat/runtime/kv-cache-ttl`. Keep it under ~50 chars ideally.
Priya: PRs should be small and focused — target <400 LOC, one logical change per PR. add a short description, what motivated it, and testing notes.
Sam: also run `make smoke` and `./scripts/check_lint.sh` locally before pushing. CI will run unit + integration. if CI flakes, push an empty commit `git commit --allow-empty -m "retry CI"` after rebasing.
Alex: thanks! any guidance on commit message format or squash vs merge?
Priya: we squash merge. commit message should follow `scope: short summary` — e.g., `runtime: tighten kv cache TTL (#1234)` — and include the issue/epic if relevant. if there's an API change, add a line in CHANGELOG under Unreleased.
Taylor: for reviewers: ping me for infra/deploy impacts, ping @Priya for runtime logic. if it's just docs or devex UX, ping me and @Sam. we try to assign 2 reviewers for non-trivial changes.
Alex: good to know. Anything I should include in the PR description template?
Priya: yep — paste this short checklist in the PR body (you can copy):
```
- Summary: one-liner
- Motivation: why this change
- Test plan: what you ran locally/CI
- Rollout plan: any config flags or gradual rollout
- Backwards compatibility notes
```
Priya: also add labels: `area/runtime`, `risk/low|medium|high` and `needs-review`
Sam: small tip — if the change touches runtime hot paths, include a quick before/after perf snapshot (latency p50/p95 for a representative prompt). makes reviews faster.
OnboardingBot: Helpful links: https://redwood.dev/docs/pr-guidelines | https://redwood.dev/handbook/branching. New hire checklist: run `./scripts/bootstrap` and grant access to the `dedicated-gpus` group if needed.
Alex: awesome, thanks all — I'll open the PR shortly and tag @Priya + @Taylor. :party-parrot:
Priya: welcome aboard again! ping if you hit any infra perms/errors, we can do a 15-min walkthrough.
